description: A young woman with fair skin and dark hair styled in a messy updo is captured in profile against a vibrant neon red and yellow background. Her delicate features, including a sharp nose and full lips, are softly illuminated by the warm glow of the neon lights. Strands of hair fall loosely around her face, adding a casual and artistic touch to her appearance. She wears a subtle ear cuff on her left ear, visible in the image. The neon lights behind her create a hazy, dreamlike atmosphere, with the blurred text adding an urban, modern aesthetic.
